correctness.rationale: The exterior-degree decomposition splits [r,r] into independent Λ²V∧Z, V∧Λ²Z and Λ³Z pieces. The three distinguished coefficients in [A,A] force A=0 over char !=2. Then [B,B] is exactly tr(adj B) times the generator Λ³Z. The rank-nine quadratic form has nondegenerate polar form (3-variable block determinant 2 and three hyperbolic pairs); hence irreducible affine cone dimension 8 and singular vertex. The odd-dimensional nondegenerate quadratic-zero count is q^8, times q^3 free central tensors = q^11. The induced cobracket is injective as a map from B in odd characteristic, hence q^8 distinct cobrackets. The standalone direct tensor-equation checker was executed, with finite limits stated.
